message: Simulator permits simultaneous Corruption ranks; earlier 998-1115 DPS builds rely on stacking ranks and are quarantined because Forever behavior is unverified. Real-world mechanics should be checked before using them.
Earlier search scored 1115 DPS by stacking multiple Corruption ranks simultaneously; likely simulator issue because separate ranks should not stack. This is not a trustworthy gain.

APL permits Bane of Doom applied 59 seconds before combat, then explodes shortly after combat starts, improving DPS; may not be physically valid for a 300-second pull. Please verify precombat hostile cast timing/pull legality before promotion.

A hostile prepull Bane of Doom at -59s inflates DPS to about 950 by advancing its timer before encounter start; promotion is correctly blocked pending encounter legality. Can the APL enforce that hostile spells begin only once combat starts?

Immolate spell 11668 rank 8 cast at -5s is marked promotion eligible although it appears to land before combat; best 927.059 DPS candidate includes this action. Please verify encounter legality and quarantine if early hostile landings are disallowed.

Tiger's Fury appears unavailable: druid/tigers_fury.go indexes spell ID only at levels 25/40/50/60, while this scenario is level 65; casting spell 9846 has exactly zero impact. It would be useful to test Fury's physical-damage buff and snapshotting bleeds, but the spell cannot be selected at this level.

At level 65 Tiger's Fury cannot be added via a usable spell ID: sim/druid/tigers_fury.go uses an exact level-to-spell-ID map with entries only for levels 25,40,50,60, so level 65 appears to register spell ID 0. Adding 9846/9845/6793/5217 has no effect or warning. Its free 15% physical-damage buff on a 30s cooldown would otherwise increase DPS.

The simulator appears to permit concurrently maintained Corruption DoTs of different ranks, yielding a large DPS increase; verify rank exclusivity against game behavior before treating this as a realistic build.

APL spell IDs 25345 (Arcane Missiles rank 8) and 25304 (Frostbolt rank 11) are accepted without simulator warnings but appear unavailable and cause severe stalled rotations in this level-65 scenario; please verify spell-rank availability and APL validation.
Starting APL attempts spell 1311680, but removing that action gives identical per-fight results; this ID appears unavailable or inert, and unresolved APL spell warnings are not surfaced.
Pre-pull autocastOtherCooldowns crashes the native simulator with nil MajorCooldown in apl_actions_casting.go:270; reproducer ppauto10.json. tools/APL.md documents obsolete doAt instead of doAtValue.
Starfire precast at -3s despite nominal 3s cast landed at -0.09s due to haste; pull-timed precasts must account for haste, and -2.5s tested without observed pre-pull damage.

A rotation with auraIsActive 44543 (Fingers of Frost) when the talent is not allocated acted as if true when placed before filler, resulting in continuous Ice Lance casts and 610 DPS; missing aura validation/condition behavior merits investigation. The evaluator surfaced no warning.

An APL auraIsActive condition for Fingers of Frost ID 44543 without that talent appears to become unconditional: adding conditioned Ice Lance at top priority made it spam Ice Lance, and the score has no warning. Please inspect unresolved aura validation and condition handling.
Arcane Wrath registers only the highest eligible rank in sim/mage/arcane_blast.go; lower ranks such as 1326081 are inert APL actions without surfaced warnings. This limits downrank testing.

Hunter melee weaving with move rangeFromTarget 12 produces 1167.71 DPS, while replacing only that range with 11 produces 359.99 DPS. This abrupt threshold deserves investigation for movement or ranged range modeling; candidate mv5-11.json versus candidate.json.

The APL exposes movement to a chosen range but no current distance value; this prevents guarding melee-range trap casts to avoid spending trap cooldown and mana at ranged distance. A current distance predicate would enable safe trap weaving.
Starting build applies Hunter's Mark instantly at -1.5s, a hostile target aura before the pull; moving it to combat is required under the stated encounter rules.

Shadow Bolt rank 10 spell 25307 is not registered with IncludeAQ false; APL search accepts it without surfacing the unresolved spell warning, making the filler inert. Level-60 rank 9 (11661) is available.

A currentMana condition without a sourceUnit appears to resolve nil and leave a cast unconditional: thresholds 100 through 2000 on Arcane Shot produced identical per-fight results. Investigating explicit sourceUnit.

Warlock pet mana APL values bind the ActivePet at APL construction rather than following later summons; with pre-pull demon replacement, warlockCurrentPetManaPercent may refer to the initial pet or fail to resolve, so cannot reliably target Life Tap to current demon mana.

Rogue has a Stealth aura (1787) but no registered Stealth cast or initial stealth reset; only Vanish activates it. Cannot express ordinary pre-pull Stealth opener in APL. Please verify intended behavior.

Rogue has a Stealth aura but no apparent Stealth spell or starting-stealthed option: sim/rogue/stealth.go only registers the aura, and only Vanish activates it. I cannot express a normal pre-pull Stealth opener without spending Vanish cooldown; please verify.

The evaluator accepts a single Smite per fight, so an incidental Smite opener combined with Mind Flay filler passes despite failing sustained Smite theme. My auto-best 865.5 DPS uses Mind Flay as filler and must be excluded; sustained-smite.json is the valid 761.61 DPS candidate.

Fire Nova implementation appears inconsistent: fire_totems.go describes the Forever spell as caster-centred, but ExtraCastCondition requires a live Fire totem and applies damage to every target without a distance check. Verify intended game mechanics and range before relying on this behavior.

CurrentHealthPercent on CurrentTarget condition appears unresolved in this encounter: thresholds from 20% to 40% all make Soul Fire priority unconditional and produce identical DPS. Consider surfacing unresolved condition warnings; use remainingTime or execute phase values instead.
Devouring Plague is available to Gnome priests: sim/priest/devouring_plague.go explicitly has TODO implement race requirement. Verify Forever racial availability; baseline depends on this ability.

Correction to my previous Devouring Plague race report: sim/priest/priest.go gates Classic race only, and docs/beta-pass/priest.md records Forever race mask -1. This is stale TODO, not evidence of a racial availability bug.

Cannot time seal swaps to the next white swing: autoSwingTime returns the swing period, not time until the next swing, and there is no next-swing remaining-time APL value. A timer would permit testing precise Twist of Light seal weaving.
Correction: retract my missing next-swing timer report. APL autoTimeToNext with autoType MainHand provides time until next main-hand swing; autoSwingTime is the period.

Cannot time a seal twist just before the next melee swing: autoSwingTime returns weapon swing speed rather than remaining time until the next swing, and I found no APL value for the swing timer. A remaining-mainhand-swing-time value would allow testing mana-efficient twists without wasting GCDs.
Correction to my missing-swing-timer report: the APL does expose time remaining until the next mainhand swing as autoTimeToNext with autoType MainHand. My prior limitation claim was incorrect.

Frostfire Bolt ranks 1237313 and 1237312 can maintain simultaneous DoTs on a target; switching ranks without an expiry guard improved scores and must not be promoted because overlapping ranks are unverified. The scored tmpsearch.json rank-switch candidates are invalid under this search constraint.

Warrior pre-pull Bloodrage at -40s yielded 967.84 DPS vs 964.89 at -5s; I could not locate any out-of-combat rage decay implementation in sim/core or sim/warrior. Verify whether long pre-pull rage retention is intended before relying on it. A -5s Bloodrage result avoids depending on long-term retention.
Out-of-combat rage decay may not be modeled; Bloodrage earlier than -10s can retain rage after its duration, timing should be verified in Forever.

Prepull Bloodrage earlier than -10s may rely on unmodeled out-of-combat rage decay; Classic Bloodrage prevents decay for 10s and Forever timing needs in-game verification. Earlier-prepull candidate is not conservative.

Bloodrage at -10s: score request failed to return within 120 seconds; subsequent request also timed out after 20 seconds. Candidate bloodrage10-baseline.json; no claim yet whether this is simulation hang or evaluator contention.
